reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: function exists and has 2 non-test callers (src/app/actions.ts:60, src/app/kiosk/page.tsx:34) plus GRANT EXECUTE TO anon. Gate 2: no trust_assumptions table; attack path uses anon role with no authentication requirement. Gate 3: supabase/migrations/ is in-scope and race condition on this RPC is explicitly listed in key_security_concerns. An attacker (or physical NFC double-tap) can trigger this via the anonymous `attendance.record_attendance_by_card` RPC by firing two simultaneous requests for the same card_id, causing both transactions to read the same v_last_type under READ COMMITTED isolation and insert duplicate records, corrupting the clock-in/clock-out state for the victim user.
